title: Harbor Fog
caption: Dark jazz noir instrumental, very slow and atmospheric. Deep baritone saxophone long notes, bowed and plucked upright bass, sparse brushed drums with lots of space, a distant Rhodes electric piano with tremolo, low reverb like an empty warehouse by the docks. Brooding, ominous, fog over the harbour. Warm analog sound. No vocals.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration C).
